purpose: Bind any future commercial legal approval to exact customer-facing document versions, immutable digests, reviewer authority, effective locations and a release scope without inventing legal approval in source.

activation_gate.rule: Legal approval is not activated by templates or repository state. Every customer-facing document must be approved, digest-bound, externally reachable where applicable, reviewer-attributed, and scoped to the intended commercial release before legal_evidence_complete can become true.
